name: nested-vaul-drawer
title: Nested Vaul Drawer
description: A black stage with a single Open Drawer button. Clicking it raises a dark bottom sheet with a drag handle, a title and text, and buttons inside open further sheets layered on top, each dismissed by swiping or tapping away.
use: A mobile or tablet flow needs layers of detail shown as stacked bottom sheets with swipe to close.
avoid: The sheets assume a dark page, and the copy talks about the drawer's own code rather than real content.
a11y: The dialog library traps focus and closes on Escape, but the spring sheet motion has no reduced-motion guard. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Idle, just a small white rounded button on black. Opened, a charcoal sheet rises from the bottom with a short grab handle, a bold title, two or three grey paragraphs and a full-width pale button. A nested sheet covers most of it, repeating the handle, title, copy and button.
behaves: Clicking the button slides a sheet up over a dimmed backdrop with a springy settle. The inner buttons push new sheets up on top of the previous ones, and dragging the handle down or tapping the backdrop closes them in order.
customise: The titles, notes, footer links and three nested levels are hardcoded inside the drawers; colours come from theme tokens.
weight: light: Three static sheets with spring transitions; nothing runs until a drawer is opened.
